label: TP
reason: User-controlled data from Referer header flows directly to response.getWriter().format() without proper sanitization. The format() method treats its first argument as a format string pattern, allowing % sequences in user input to be interpreted as format specifiers causing XSS.

evidence.note: Data flows from getHeaders() -> decode() -> doSomething() -> format() sink without effective neutralization
Sink location where tainted data reaches format() method vulnerable to XSS
